_meta.name: donatelli.tech placeholder registry
_meta.rule: Every fact on the security page, the credentials section and the trust blocks that is not yet true lives here with value null and status pending. Fill value, set status to verified, rebuild. Nothing else on the page needs to change. A pending entry renders as a visible PENDING marker, never as prose, so no page ships a false claim.

statuses.pending: Not yet true or not yet confirmed by the owner. Renders as a marker.
statuses.verified: True today. The verify field says how a reader can check it.

_meta.how_to_fill: Set value to the exact public string. Set status to verified. Keep verify accurate: it is printed next to the value so the reader can check it themselves. Set date to the day you confirmed it.

owner_name.label: Person
owner_name.verify: Same name on the intro call, on the proposal, and on every invoice.
owner_name.note: Full legal name is Nicolas Donatelli; the site uses Nick. Keep one form everywhere.

owner_location.label: Based in
owner_location.verify: Matches the Person record in the site's structured data (view source on any page).
owner_location.note: City-level only. Street address stays off the public page and goes on the proposal and the COI.

owner_linkedin.label: LinkedIn
owner_linkedin.verify: Public profile URL. Work history on the profile should match the practice history stated on this page.
owner_linkedin.note: Paste the public profile URL. Also add it to SITE.ownerSameAs in build.mjs so the Person schema points at it.

contact_email.label: Contact
contact_email.verify: Domain matches the site. Send a message; the reply comes from the same domain.
contact_email.note: Cloudflare Email Routing forwards to the owner's mailbox. Outbound from the domain requires the send-as setup in docs/email.md.

legal_entity.label: Legal entity
legal_entity.verify: Entity name and type as registered. For an LLC or corporation: California Secretary of State business search (bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov). For a sole proprietorship: the fictitious business name filing with the San Diego County Recorder.
legal_entity.note: Exact registered name plus type, e.g. 'Donatelli Services LLC (California)'. If sole proprietor, write 'Nicolas Donatelli, sole proprietor, doing business as Donatelli Services' and file the FBN.

business_license_number.label: Business licence
business_license_number.verify: Licence number and issuing city. Check with the issuing city's business licence lookup or by phone to its finance department.
business_license_number.note: City of San Marcos issues business licences through its Finance Department. Enter the number exactly as printed on the certificate.

business_license_issuer.label: Issued by
business_license_issuer.note: e.g. 'City of San Marcos, CA'. Fill together with business_license_number.

business_license_expires.label: Licence valid through
business_license_expires.verify: Expiry date printed on the licence.
business_license_expires.note: ISO date, e.g. 2027-06-30. Renew and update before it lapses.

practice_since.label: Practice since
practice_since.verify: Year the practice first invoiced under this name. Should agree with the entity filing date and the LinkedIn history.
practice_since.note: Year only. Do not count earlier employment as practice years.

insurance_carrier.label: Carrier
insurance_carrier.verify: Carrier name and AM Best rating are printed on the certificate of insurance.
insurance_carrier.note: e.g. 'Hiscox' or 'Next Insurance'. Fill from the declarations page.

insurance_gl_limits.label: General liability
insurance_gl_limits.verify: Per-occurrence and aggregate limits on the certificate of insurance.
insurance_gl_limits.note: Format: '$1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate'. Leave pending if no GL policy; the page then says so.

insurance_eo_limits.label: Professional liability (E&O)
insurance_eo_limits.verify: Per-claim and aggregate limits on the certificate of insurance.
insurance_eo_limits.note: Format: '$1,000,000 per claim / $1,000,000 aggregate'. Many client contracts ask for $1M per claim.

insurance_cyber_limits.label: Cyber liability
insurance_cyber_limits.verify: Limit and whether third-party (client) losses are covered, on the certificate of insurance.
insurance_cyber_limits.note: Format: '$1,000,000 per claim, first- and third-party'. Confirm third-party coverage; that is the part that protects the client.

insurance_policy_period.label: Policy period
insurance_policy_period.verify: Effective and expiry dates on the certificate of insurance.
insurance_policy_period.note: Format: '2026-10-01 to 2027-10-01'. Update at each renewal.

coi_turnaround_days.label: Certificate of insurance delivered within
coi_turnaround_days.verify: Ask for one. The date on the certificate and the date of your request are the check.
coi_turnaround_days.note: Number of business days you commit to. Most carriers issue a COI the same day from their portal; 2 is a realistic commitment.

background_check_provider.label: Background check provider
background_check_provider.verify: Provider name. The client can ask for the report summary, or run its own check through its own provider at its own cost; consent is given in writing.
background_check_provider.note: e.g. 'Checkr' or 'Sterling'. Order an individual check on yourself, keep the report.

background_check_date.label: Background check
background_check_date.verify: Report date printed on the summary.
background_check_date.note: ISO date. Re-run yearly and update.

background_check_scope.label: Background check scope
background_check_scope.note: e.g. 'Identity, national criminal, county criminal (San Diego), sex-offender registry'. Copy the report's own wording.

reference_count.label: References available
reference_count.verify: Ask. Each reference is a named person at a past client, introduced by email, who agreed in advance to take the call.
reference_count.note: Number of past clients who have agreed in writing to take a reference call. Only count people who said yes this year.

engagements_completed.label: Engagements completed
engagements_completed.verify: Count of fixed-price engagements delivered and closed. Each has a signed proposal and a dated access-removal confirmation on file; a prospect can ask to see a redacted one.
engagements_completed.note: Integer. Count only engagements with a signed proposal and a closed handoff.

nda_template_url.label: Mutual NDA
nda_template_url.verify: Read it before the intro call. Send redlines by email; the signed copy is the one that governs.
nda_template_url.note: Link to a PDF of the mutual NDA you offer. The page also states that the client's own NDA is fine.

questionnaire_turnaround_days.label: Security questionnaire answered within
questionnaire_turnaround_days.verify: Send one. The dates on the email thread are the check.
questionnaire_turnaround_days.note: Business days you commit to for a written answer to a client security questionnaire. 5 is realistic for a solo practice.

incident_notice_hours.label: Incident notice within
incident_notice_hours.verify: Written into the proposal as a term. The proposal is the check.
incident_notice_hours.note: Hours from the moment you know of a suspected compromise of a device, account, or client data. 24 is the common contract figure; 72 is the GDPR ceiling. Pick what you will honour.

incident_writeup_days.label: Written incident report within
incident_writeup_days.verify: Written into the proposal as a term.
incident_writeup_days.note: Business days from notice to a written report: what happened, what was touched, what changed. 5 is realistic.

data_deletion_days.label: Working copies deleted within
data_deletion_days.verify: You get a dated email listing what was deleted and what was kept (the signed proposal, the invoices, and the access-removal email). That email is the check.
data_deletion_days.note: Days after handoff by which working copies of client data on your devices and accounts are deleted. 30 is common.

password_manager.label: Password manager
password_manager.verify: On the intro call, on request: a screen-share of the vault settings page showing the second factor enabled.
password_manager.note: Product name, e.g. '1Password'. Every credential you hold lives in it; nothing in a spreadsheet, note, or browser store.

mfa_method.label: Second factor
mfa_method.verify: On the intro call, on request: a screen-share of the security page of the practice's email and password-manager accounts.
mfa_method.note: e.g. 'Hardware security key (FIDO2) where supported, authenticator app elsewhere; no SMS codes'. State exactly what you use.

device_baseline.label: Work device
device_baseline.verify: On the intro call, on request: a screen-share of the disk-encryption and screen-lock settings.
device_baseline.note: e.g. 'One laptop. Full-disk encryption on, automatic OS updates on, screen lock at 5 minutes, no client data on removable media.' State what is true.

site_hosting.label: This site
site_hosting.value: Cloudflare Pages, static, with a strict Content-Security-Policy and HSTS
site_hosting.verify: Run `curl -I https://donatelli.tech` and read the content-security-policy and strict-transport-security headers.
site_hosting.note: True from _headers in build.mjs. If hosting changes, change this.

scheduler.label: Scheduling
scheduler.verify: The booking page at /book/ frames cal.com/donatelli.tech.
scheduler.note: The booking form collects name, email and the call time. Nothing else.

page_reviewed.label: Last reviewed
page_reviewed.verify: Printed at the foot of the page. Every change to a row in this table is a dated entry in the registry file behind the page; ask by email and I send the change log.
page_reviewed.note: Update whenever any entry in this registry changes.
